question: What is the average price of RPG games released 2015-2018? (A) about $12.60 (B) $17.50 (C) $15.00. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: A (about $12.60). Bait: C ($15.00).
